chapters.register: ordinary social diffusion with one weak follow-up cue
external payoff, offer materiality and classmate convergence

why_it_improved: Ch1 is no longer self-contained: its reproducibility package reappears as an unread follow-up in Ch2 and receives a concrete recruitment payoff in Ch5.
Ch2 remains ordinary-world texture; the connective message is peripheral and does not turn the trip into networking setup.
Ch3 now remembers Zhou's inspectable technical evidence through an existing classmate relation, while Sun Jie refuses to let Luo borrow another profession's proof form.
Ch4 makes failure-log practice visible in another research relationship, showing limited method diffusion without making Xu Hang the protagonist of the network.
Ch5 converts prior preparation into contingent consequences and physically brings Zhou/Gao/Luo together through a historically existing classmate dinner.
what_still_remains_weak: The first five chapters still do not share a single causal mainline; this is now an intentional ensemble property rather than an accidental omission.
Xu Hang remains a high-frequency connector in Chapters1/2/4. He should recede for several chapters.
The reproducibility/failure-record motif is now sufficiently visible; do not keep repeating it as a franchise symbol.
Song Nan's introduction in Chapter2 has not yet received a major personal payoff. Her industry threshold should later grow from her own arc, not from Xu Hang.
Gao Yuan enters only in Chapter5; Chapter6 must deepen him through concrete choice rather than retrospective biography.

negative_space_check.note: Connections are carried by messages, remembered peer practice, repeated work habits and later outcomes; no narrator explains the braid or announces a shared theme.

campbell_check.note: The sequence now contains call/ordinary/trial/trial/threshold beats across different people without pretending these beats form one synchronized hero journey.

next_recommendation: Advance to the preserved Gao Yuan / Chen Lan choice chapter. Keep Xu and Tang off center; emphasize city, time, response burden, family geography and the fact that acceptance/refusal are different Campbell functions rather than opposite moral answers.
